description: Llama 3 is Meta's third-generation open-weights LLM, available in 8B and 70B parameter sizes. It features an 8K context window and significantly improved performance over Llama 2. Superseded by Llama 3.1 for most use cases.

trainingData.description: Trained on 15+ trillion tokens from publicly available sources.

trainingProcedure: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

evaluation.performanceSummary: Significant improvement over Llama 2. Strong performance on reasoning and coding tasks for its generation.

knownLimitations: Superseded by Llama 3.1 with longer context (8K vs 128K)
May generate incorrect or misleading information

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied during training.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: RLHF alignment and safety tuning applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

licenseTerms: Separate license required for >700M monthly active users

hardware.70B: High-end GPU required, ~140GB VRAM for full precision
